title: PEAQ PTV 43AQU-5023C (Changhong, reports brand OK. / model "AI PONT", device dundas), Android TV 11
header:
PEAQ PTV 43AQU-5023C (Changhong, reports brand OK. / model "AI PONT", device dundas), Android TV 11
(API 30), firmware RTMA.250416.196, MediaTek m7332, 1920x1080, about 1.3 GB RAM (MemTotal 1405164 kB).
Same Homwee vendor layer as examples/ok-ai-pont-ikebukuro; this list starts from that one.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/peaq-ptv43aqu-5023c/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/peaq-ptv43aqu-5023c/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher. Shipped disabled: com.cltv.fast, com.google.android.marvin.talkback.
The one saved Wi-Fi network belongs to setupwraith, so setupwraith is left alone. Only tvlauncher and
com.android.tv.settings/.system.FallbackHome answer HOME.
Tested on one set on 21 Oct 2026, the same day and through one reboot, not a multi-day soak. Done over the
tools/relay.py relay (macOS Local Network privacy blocked direct ADB).
Disabled in batches with a screenshot between each; every package stayed disabled through a reboot. Then
launcher/build-and-install.sh set com.gathin.tvhome as Home (mFocusedApp checked, also after the reboot) and
tools/theme.sh pushed config.json. Checked: D-pad across dock, grid and top bar; Inputs lists HDMI 1-3, AV and
Live TV; YouTube, Netflix and Spotify play with AdGuard Private DNS on; the remote's Netflix, YouTube, Input
and Settings buttons still work without tvlauncher.

KEEP: com.homwee.dmt.upgrade and com.homwee.upgrade (updates), com.homwee.synckey (remote keys),
com.homwee.chtvmanager, com.homwee.factory, com.mediatek.* (Live TV, inputs, remote pairing, picture),
com.google.android.apps.mediashell (Chromecast) and com.homwee.multiscreenshare / mmp.screenshare
(mirroring), both used on this set.
